200.description: The report rows for the window.

rows.description: One row per (pathId, hour bucket). Always present; empty for a window with no data.

hourBucket.description: Start of the UTC hour this row aggregates.

workReleased.description: WorkReleased events. Work admitted into the path.

backlogThresholdBreached.description: BacklogThresholdBreached events. The backlog crossed its alarm threshold.

pathThrottled.description: PathThrottled events. Flow balancing throttled upstream release.

rateDeviationDetected.description: RateDeviationDetected events. Reserved: the event is declared but never raised today, so this is always 0.

400.description: `from` or `to` is missing or not RFC 3339, or `granularity` is not `hour` (`invalid-report-query`).
